It would take **5 minutes**.

Each machine makes 1 widget in 5 minutes. The rate is the same per machine, so with 100 machines working in parallel, each one still makes its own widget in 5 minutes. Total output scales with the number of machines, so 100 machines make 100 widgets in the same 5 minutes.

Rate check: 5 machines × (1 widget / 5 min) = 1 widget/min, so 5 widgets take 5 minutes. 100 machines × (1 widget / 5 min) = 20 widgets/min, so 100 widgets would take $\frac{100}{20} = 5$ minutes.
